📢 Newly posted (published August 28, 2026)

Hanno City is accepting intake consultations for children with developmental delays, allergies, or medical care needs who wish to attend a municipal childcare facility in April 2027 (Reiwa 9) or during the 2027 fiscal year.

【Schedule】
Children with developmental delays or allergies: October 8, 9, 13, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM
Children requiring medical care: October 6, 7, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM

【Location】
Yamate Childcare Center (1F, 19-4 Yamate-cho, Hanno)

【What to expect】
Please bring your child with you. Staff including childcare workers, health nurses, a nutritionist, and a counselor will observe your child and discuss developmental history and home life with you.

【How to apply】
This requires advance reservation. Call the Childcare Division at 042-973-2111 or visit the Childcare Division window at City Hall between September 1 and September 24, 2026 (Reiwa 8). Please fill out and bring a health and development form on the day of your consultation.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kodomoshienbu/hoikuka/ninteikyufu/8236.html
summary: ℹ️ Intake consultations for children needing special care at municipal childcare facilities
